design_philosophy.target_audience: Small business owners in India (Mobile-first, budget devices)
design_philosophy.key_principle: Faux Glass & High Contrast - Premium feel without performance cost

headings.usage: Use for all section headers, modal titles, and hero text. Tight tracking (-0.02em).

body.usage: Use for all paragraphs, inputs, and UI labels. Excellent legibility at small sizes.

mono.usage: Use for API keys, webhooks, and code snippets.

secondary.description: Slate 100 - Soft background for secondary actions.

accent.description: Emerald 500 - Success state, 5-star ratings, growth metrics.

glassmorphism.usage: Sticky headers, Modals, Floating Action Buttons (FAB), Toast notifications.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-semibold shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all duration-200
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium hover:bg-slate-50 transition-all

cards.default: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-100 shadow-sm p-6
cards.interactive: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-100 shadow-sm p-6 hover:border-indigo-100 hover:shadow-md transition-all cursor-pointer

inputs.default: h-12 rounded-lg border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500/20 focus:border-indigo-500 transition-all

hero_business_owner.alt: Happy Indian business owner managing reviews on phone
hero_business_owner.usage: Landing page hero section, right side (desktop) or top (mobile)

ai_background.usage: Subtle background overlay for 'Magic Search' or 'AI Features' section

review_submission_flow.structure: Wizard Step Form (1. Rating -> 2. Content -> 3. Details)
review_submission_flow.mobile_optimization: Single column, large tap targets (48px+), auto-focus on input.
review_submission_flow.wow_factor: When user clicks 5 stars, trigger confetti or star-pop animation. If < 4 stars, show 'How can we improve?' with a caring, softer UI.

magic_search.behavior: User types business name -> Real-time list populates with Google/FB icons -> One tap to connect.
magic_search.visuals: Glassmorphic modal backdrop, high contrast list items.

qr_landing_page.layout: Card-based layout centered on screen (not full width text).
qr_landing_page.visuals: Looks like a premium 'Invitation' card. QR code is the hero. 'Scan to Review' CTA is bold.

universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text unless it's a very large headline.
Ensure all text has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against the background.
Use 'gap-4' or 'gap-6' for mobile layouts to prevent clutter.
All interactive elements must have a ':active' state (scale down 0.98) for tactile feedback.
